reviews.title: Well worth it
reviews.comment: Great value for the money. Is Compatable with windows 10/11. Good write speed. Easy to install. Functions as it should. Love the 2 TB storage at a great price.

reviews.title: Middle of the road
reviews.comment: Affordable, decent write speeds, stable when in use. If you need an affordable 2tb M.2 Nmve, this will do. Not the fastest, not the slowest. will be enough for the average PC owner/ builder/ upgrader
reviews.author: Brian
